answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 5594 Country: India Title: If a person has accumulated some wealth by haram means say (by working in a bank, or by stealing, or by earning through interest etc) but now he wants to earn through halal means and starts a halal business but through the money he earned by haram means? So can he start his business with that money that he had earned before? Question: If a person has accumulated some wealth by haram means say (by working in a bank, or by stealing, or by earning through interest etc) but now he wants to earn through halal means and starts a halal business but through the money he earned by haram means? So can he start his business with that money that he had earned before? Answer ID: 5594 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 211/211=M/1429) It is in Dur-e-Mukhtar: الحرمة تتعدد مع العلم بها it means that when a thing is known as haram (unlawful), its unlawfulness is transmittable. Therefore, it is not good to start lawful business with money earned by unlawful way. The stolen money must be returned to the owners or his heirs. It is necessary to give the interest money gotten form a bank to the poor. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
